about: Hand-maintained race list for Paddle Tracker, from the owner's race schedule. Race details come from organisers' sites and public reports, and each race links to its PaddleGuru page. Past prone results for some races were read from PaddleGuru's public results pages (owner's decision 2026-11-28; see src/paddle/sources/paddleguru.py). status 'draft — confirm' = not yet checked by the owner; 'date TBA' = next season, date not posted. Edit with: python -m src.paddle.races set <id> --date YYYY-MM-DD [--start HH:MM] [--url URL]
